title: nodeagent image digest mismatch and webhook CA skew causing post-upgrade operator crash in customer clusters
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Multiple customer Private clusters (notably BrightBank and AeroRetail) reported operator crashloops and webhook rejections immediately after an automated Helm upgrade from runtime 1.12.0 -> 1.12.1. Root cause appears to be two simultaneous skewed conditions: (1) the nodeagent image referenced by the release manifest was removed from the upstream registry and a new digest was pushed under the same tag between CI artifact publish and chart rendering, causing ImagePullBackOff/crashloop; (2) the mutating/validating webhook CA bundle in the Helm chart was rotated independently by our release automation resulting in webhook TLS verification failures (conversion/mutation requests rejected) for existing kube objects. This ticket tracks triage, hotfix, customer coordination, and follow-up engineering work to prevent recurrence.
reproducible_steps: 1) Install runtime-1.12.0 on a fresh k8s 1.27 cluster using the existing helm chart and operator image tag 'redwood/operator:1.12.0'.
2) Simulate release pipeline by publishing a new nodeagent image with the same tag but different digest and delete original digest from test registry (private test only).
3) Run helm upgrade to runtime-1.12.1 that references the moved tag; observe operator ImagePullBackOff or crashloop due to digest mismatch in environments that validate digests.
4) Separately, patch the MutatingWebhookConfiguration caBundle to an unrelated value and attempt to apply CRs to verify webhook TLS rejects requests.
investigation_notes: 03/10 09:12 UTC - Support alert: BrightBank reported multiple operator pods in CrashLoopBackOff after an automated upgrade initiated by their platform team.

03/10 09:40 UTC - Triage: reproduced in staging by forcing the release pipeline to re-publish a nodeagent tag with a different digest. Verified image referenced by helm values.yaml did not match registry state.

03/10 12:00 UTC - Discovered mutation: release tooling rotated webhook CA bundle in separate step; helm chart values shipped with new caBundle without performing a rolling restart for existing CRs, leading to immediate webhook validation failures until webhook pods reloaded with the new CA.

03/10 14:20 UTC - Confirmed two simultaneous failure modes: image digest drift + webhook CA skew. Either alone might be recoverable; together they blocked automated in-place remediation in customer clusters.
03/11 02:05 UTC - Customer-communication call run with BrightBank and AeroRetail; they requested immediate rollback and a guaranteed remediation path for remaining clusters.
mitigation: Temporarily paused automated upgrades for all active Private clusters via control plane toggle (feature flag: private.auto_upgrade=false).

For impacted clusters we provided an emergency runbook: kubectl rollout undo for operator StatefulSet if previous image digest present; otherwise kubectl set image to a previously cached digest we uploaded to our customer-accessible registry mirror.

Applied a manual patch to MutatingWebhookConfiguration/ValidatingWebhookConfiguration caBundle to match the new operator server cert for clusters where webhook pods had been rotated, then restarted webhook pods where necessary.
Opened an immediate mirror in our registry for the original nodeagent digest and pushed the missing digest back into the customer-accessible mirror to unblock ImagePulls.
fix_summary: Create runtime-1.12.1-hotfix1 that pins nodeagent images by immutable digest in the chart templates instead of floating tags (chart change: templates/images.yaml and values.schema).

Add preflight validation in the Helm upgrade pipeline that ensures every image digest referenced in the rendered chart exists in the target registry and is reachable from the customer's cluster network (registry-check step).

Adjust release automation so webhook CA rotation is atomically coupled with a managed rolling restart of webhook deployments and a post-apply validation step for webhook readiness (fail-fast on mismatch).
Add cluster-scoped migration job for affected clusters to reconcile MutatingWebhookConfiguration caBundle safely when CA rotation is required in the future.
rollout_plan: Build and publish runtime-1.12.1-hotfix1 images and chart artifacts to staging registry (03/11 08:00 UTC).
Create PR #7654 (runtime/charts) with chart pin and registry-check step. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7654
Smoke deploy hotfix to internal integration clusters, run automated upgrade pipeline with --dry-run checks, then a real upgrade on one non-customer cluster (03/11 12:00 UTC).

Coordinate with Customer Success and affected customers to schedule staggered hotfix upgrades during low-traffic windows. Provide an outage-free path when possible and a rollback command set if needed.
Mark release as hotfix and increment changelog; publish customer advisory after verification (03/12 target).
verification_steps: On a test cluster: helm upgrade --install runtime -f values-hotfix.yaml runtime-chart-1.12.1-hotfix1.tgz and verify operator Pods reach Ready state within configured PodStartupTimeout.

Run 'kubectl get mutatingwebhookconfiguration redwood-webhook -o jsonpath="{.webhooks[*].clientConfig.caBundle}"' and compare to the operator-serving TLS cert; requests to the webhook should succeed (tested by applying a sample CR and observing admission success).
Network check: ensure registry-check step passes from a customer-like network path (simulate private registry firewall rules).
Post-upgrade monitor: 48h elevated telemetry for operator restarts, webhook 5xx rates, CR mutation errors; if any metrics exceed threshold, rollback and investigate.
customer_communication: 03/10 15:00 UTC - Incident notification sent to BrightBank and AeroRetail with initial mitigation steps and ETA for hotfix.
03/11 19:00 UTC - Provided targeted remediation commands and offered assisted upgrade with engineering on-call present.
03/12 10:00 UTC - Customer advisory drafted for broader customer base explaining root causes, immediate mitigations, and next steps. Will schedule webinar for customers with >100 nodes.
postmortem_actions: Implement digest pin enforcement in release CI and chart linting (owner: infra-ci team, due 2026-04-01).
Add end-to-end test that simulates CA rotation + upgrade in CI integration lane (owner: operator team, due 2026-03-31).
Add registry retention policy notes and change request to prevent garbage-collection of recently-referenced digests for 14 days post-release (owner: releases team, due 2026-04-10).
Update on-prem upgrade runbook to include ordered steps for webhook CA rotation and operator redeploy to avoid split-brain conditions.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-52742 - add registry-check step to CI pipeline (create separate ticket).
ENG-52743 - implement chart schema enforcement for digest pinning.
ENG-52744 - update onprem runbook and customer-facing KB article with graphic flows.
notes: Decision made 03/11: hotfix route preferred over rolling rollback for clusters where image digest cannot be restored quickly because hotfix includes both registry-check and caBundle-handling improvements.
